question: A sum of ₹625 amounts to ₹841 in 2 years at a certain rate of interest per annum, compounded annually. The rate of interest per annum is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of Amount to Principal for 2 years = 841 / 625

For 1 year, we take the square root of the ratio: √(841 / 625) = 29 / 25

This means a principal of ₹25 amounts to ₹29 in 1 year.

Interest for 1 year = 29 − 25 = 4

Rate of interest = (4 / 25) × 100 = 16%

**∴ The correct answer is 16%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹625

Amount (A) = ₹841

Time (n) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Amount = P × (1 + R/100)ⁿ

 
• 
 

 
 Principal
 ₹625
 
 Amount
 ₹841
 Time = 2 years
 Rate = R% p.a. (CI)

**Calculations:**

⇒ 841 = 625 × (1 + R/100)²

⇒ 841 / 625 = (1 + R/100)²

⇒ (29 / 25)² = (1 + R/100)²

⇒ 29 / 25 = 1 + R/100

⇒ R/100 = (29 / 25) − 1

⇒ R/100 = (29 − 25) / 25

⇒ R/100 = 4 / 25

⇒ R = (4 × 100) / 25

⇒ R = 16

**∴ The correct answer is 16%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effective Rate of Compound Interest

For 2 years, the effective rate of CI can be calculated directly using the successive percentage formula: Rₑff = 2R + (R² / 100)%.

Half-Yearly & Quarterly Compounding

If compounded half-yearly, Rate = R/2 and Time = 2n. If compounded quarterly, Rate = R/4 and Time = 4n.

Difference Between CI and SI for 2 Years

The difference between Compound Interest and Simple Interest for 2 years is given by the formula: Difference = P × (R / 100)².
